record.body:
## Rationale

A declared kind plus an allowlist of runner templates is enforceable without parsing pytest. Interaction claims cannot silently use the default unit template.

## Counter-argument

Path conventions need no schema. They are easy to violate with a unit test in an interaction folder, so they do not meet the phase exit.

payload.alternatives: path conventions only; pytest markers/AST classification
payload.choice: claims declare evidence_kind unit|integration|interaction; verdict refuses a witness whose runner template is not allowed for that kind; interaction requires a non-default runner template

record.subject: evidence-kind-enforcement
